repos.description: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

repos.description: 一站式原生AI PPT生成应用，几分钟内生成一套幻灯片; 支持上传任意模板图片，上传任意素材&智能解析，一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT，口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt、视频等 - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana/gpt-image🏞️
repos.summary_zh: 基于nano banana pro🍌原生AI驱动的PPT生成工具，支持一句话/大纲/页面描述快速创作，具备智能素材解析、自然语言局部修改和一键导出可编辑PPTX功能，实现真正的'Vibe PPT'体验。
repos.summary_en: An AI-native slides generator powered by nano banana pro🍌, enabling rapid PPT creation from ideas, outlines, or descriptions with intelligent material parsing, natural language-based local edits, and one-click export to editable PPTX format.

repos.description: Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides / PDF. Multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama). BYOK, local-first, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Open CoDesign 是一款开源的 Claude Design 替代工具，支持一键导入 Claude Code/Codex API 密钥，将提示词转换为原型、幻灯片或 PDF。支持多模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini/Kimi/GLM/Ollama），采用 BYOK 和本地优先架构，MIT 许可，适合 AI 驱动的设计自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Open CoDesign is an open-source alternative to Claude Design that converts prompts into polished prototypes, slides, or PDFs using your own API keys. Supports multi-model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Ollama), BYOK, and local-first architecture with MIT license for AI-powered design automation.

repos.description: MarkDown在线简历工具，可在线预览、编辑和生成PDF。[此项目已不再维护，建议使用 cv.ftqq.com 替代 ]
repos.summary_zh: DeerResume 是一款功能强大的 Markdown 在线简历工具，支持实时编辑、预览、密码保护和一键生成 PDF。用户可自主部署，自由定制样式，适用于技术岗位简历制作，尤其适合开发者使用。
repos.summary_en: DeerResume is a powerful Markdown-based online resume tool that supports real-time editing, preview, password protection, and PDF generation. It allows self-hosting with customizable styles, making it ideal for developers creating professional tech resumes.

repos.description: Hacknical, hacker & technical. A website for GitHub user to make a better resume.
repos.summary_zh: Hacknical 是一个专为 GitHub 用户打造的在线简历生成平台，通过深度分析用户的 GitHub 贡献、代码仓库、技术栈等数据，自动生成可视化分析报告，帮助用户打造专业、数据驱动的编程简历。支持中英文切换、组织账号分析、移动端展示及 PDF 导出，技术栈涵盖 React、Koa2、MongoDB 等。
repos.summary_en: Hacknical is a web platform designed for GitHub users to generate data-driven resumes by analyzing their GitHub contributions, repositories, and tech stacks. It provides visual analytics and exportable reports, supporting English, organizations, mobile viewing, and PDF export with a tech stack including React, Koa2, and MongoDB.

repos.description: MultiAgentPPT 是一个集成了 A2A（Agent2Agent）+ MCP（Model Context Protocol）+ ADK（Agent Development Kit） 架构的智能化演示文稿生成系统，支持通过多智能体协作和流式并发机制
repos.summary_zh: MultiAgentPPT 是基于 A2A+MCP+ADK 架构的多智能体演示文稿生成系统，通过大纲生成、主题拆分、并行调研和流式汇总等智能体协作，实现高质量PPT的自动化生成，支持实时编辑与下载，具备可扩展性和本地模型适配能力。
repos.summary_en: MultiAgentPPT is a multi-agent system leveraging A2A+MCP+ADK architecture to automate PPT generation through outline creation, topic splitting, parallel research, and streaming synthesis. It supports real-time editing, high-quality content, extensibility, and local model compatibility.

repos.description: :no_entry: currently unmaintained :no_entry: A minimal JS library for showing & hiding things
repos.summary_zh: Wallop 是一个轻量级（4KB）JavaScript 库，用于实现元素的显示与隐藏切换，支持移动端优先、渐进增强和纯 CSS 动画。它通过添加动态类名控制内容展示，内置多种动画修饰符（如滑动、淡入淡出），提供灵活的 API 和自定义事件，适用于轮播、选项卡等场景。
repos.summary_en: Wallop is a minimal 4kb JavaScript library for showing and hiding elements, designed with mobile-first, progressive enhancement, and CSS-based animations. It dynamically adds classes to control visibility, supports multiple animation modifiers (e.g., slide, fade), and offers a flexible API with custom events for use in sliders, tabs, and more.

repos.description: 🤙 Easy replacement for LaTeX Beamer! 🥂 custom Marp templates with a selection of over a dozen themes
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Marp 是一个基于 Markdown 的演示文稿工具，提供 38 种自定义 CSS 样式和 6 种主题，支持分栏布局、导航进度、封面页、目录页及定理框等，可替代 LaTeX Beamer。配套 VS Code 和 Obsidian，支持字体自定义，适合高效制作美观幻灯片。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Marp is a Markdown-based presentation tool offering 38 custom CSS styles and 6 themes, supporting multi-column layouts, navigation progress bars, cover pages, table of contents, and callout boxes. It replaces LaTeX Beamer with enhanced styling, integrates with VS Code and Obsidian, and allows font customization for professional slides.

repos.description: Resume template for Coder 适合程序员的简历模板 🎉
repos.summary_zh: 专为程序员设计的简历模板，基于Sketch.app制作，提供多版本（2021/2019/2018/2017/中文版）设计，突出技术能力与项目经验，支持一键导出PDF，适配不同求职场景。
repos.summary_en: A professional resume template designed for coders, built with Sketch.app. Offers multiple versions (2021/2019/2018/2017/Chinese) to showcase technical skills and project experience, with one-click PDF export for job applications.

repos.description: A lightweight, no-dependency image slider library
repos.summary_zh: PureSlider 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 图片轮播库，支持淡入淡出切换效果。它无需 jQuery 等外部库，提供简洁的 API 和自定义配置选项，适用于现代网页开发中的图片展示场景。
repos.summary_en: PureSlider is a lightweight, dependency-free image slider library that supports fade transitions. It offers a simple API and customizable options, ideal for modern web projects requiring jQuery-free image carousels.
